briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Bets on Tax Relief While National Cannabis and Psychedelics Hit New Highs
briefs.top: Michigan operators are turning the governor's race and local wins into real leverage against the 24% wholesale tax, with new dispensary formats and cap expansions showing the market still has room to grow. Nationally, psychedelics are sprinting toward FDA approval and Big Pharma dollars while cannabis rescheduling clears another courtroom hurdle and a major brand lands on the NYSE.

local.text: Menominee petition could add four dispensaries
local.text_full: Menominee petition could add four dispensaries — Organizers say they turned in more than enough signatures to put a measure on the November ballot raising the city's cap from nine stores to 13.

local.text: Muskegon's Fields Cannary targets fall opening
local.text_full: Muskegon's Fields Cannary targets fall opening — The hospitality-forward dispensary-and-restaurant buildout pushes the retail format further than most Michigan stores have gone.

local.text: Jars Cannabis wins fight over surveillance camera
local.text_full: Jars Cannabis wins fight over surveillance camera — The retailer got a Flock license-plate camera removed outside its Madison Heights location, a rare operator win on enforcement optics.

local.text: Industry cash bets on a path to tax repeal
local.text_full: Industry cash bets on a path to tax repeal — Michigan cannabis executives wrote roughly $90,000 in checks backing GOP governor nominee John James, who has pledged to repeal the state's 24% wholesale tax.

local.text: CRA's August report gives operators a compliance roadmap
local.text_full: CRA's August report gives operators a compliance roadmap — Metrc tracking issues topped the state's 21 disciplinary cases for August, spotlighting exactly where operators can tighten up before Q4 audits.

national.text: Compass Pathways lands FDA priority voucher, eyes 2027 launch
national.text_full: Compass Pathways lands FDA priority voucher, eyes 2027 launch — The FDA granted a rolling NDA review and a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher for COMP360 psilocybin, with executives targeting a first-half 2027 launch for treatment-resistant depression.

national.text: Eli Lilly closes major psychedelics acquisition
national.text_full: Eli Lilly closes major psychedelics acquisition — Lilly's buyout of atai's Beckley Psytech assets closed this month, bringing psychedelic candidates BPL-003, VLS-01 and EMP-01 under a Big Pharma pipeline.

national.text: DEA rescheduling survives another court challenge
national.text_full: DEA rescheduling survives another court challenge — The D.C. Circuit left medical marijuana's Schedule III reclassification in effect, rejecting opponents' bid to halt it while their lawsuit proceeds.

national.text: Trulieve becomes first plant-touching brand on NYSE
national.text_full: Trulieve becomes first plant-touching brand on NYSE — The multistate operator restructured around a 100% medical footprint to secure its historic listing under ticker TRLV following federal Schedule III reclassification.

national.text: Curaleaf tables takeover bid for Aurora Cannabis
national.text_full: Curaleaf tables takeover bid for Aurora Cannabis — The industry's most active dealmaker moved on Aurora in August, signaling another round of consolidation among the biggest global cannabis players.
